entityIntro: 11tik is the brand behind the YouTube Thumbnail Extractor—a free browser tool for public YouTube thumbnail images. Extractor, downloader, and grabber wording all refer to this same product, not separate tools.
entityDoes1: Extracts public YouTube thumbnail images from supported video URLs and IDs—including watch, Shorts, live, youtu.be, and embed links
entityDoes2: Validates which public thumbnail sizes actually load (including maxres when YouTube publishes it), then lets you download or copy the image URL
entityDoes3: Runs entirely in your browser (client-side), with Bulk mode for up to 50 public URLs plus ZIP and CSV export
entityDoesNot4: Extract from TikTok, Instagram, channel-only or playlist-only URLs, or other unsupported platforms
